investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Astertrel Studios (online gaming); Platform: AWS us-east-2 (zones us-east-2a/us-east-2b/us-east-2c); network range 10.109.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster astert-prod-useast (EKS); Edge: provider-managed load balancer (edge-lb) in front of game-gateway backends; a standby load balancer exists in a secondary region; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
